newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hardie says second half to be worse.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hardie says second half to be worse.

text.p: Building products group James Hardie Industries Ltd said on Friday that it expected its performance in the second half of 1996/97 to be significantly lower than in the first half.
Asked if second half results would be lower than in the first half, managing director Keith Barton said told reporters: "Significantly lower."

The company, which has Brierley Investments Ltd as its largest shareholder, earlier said its operating profit in the six months to September 30 fell 10 percent to A$34.3 million. Net profit fell 36 percent to A$14.7 million.
James Hardie suffered an 18 percent fall in 1995/96 (April/March) operating profit to A$70.8 million. Annual net profit fell by 56.8 percent to A$32.2 million.
